tool_input.command:
cat > /tmp/rebase_script.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# First line stays as pick, rest become squash
sed -i '2s/^pick/squash/' "$1"
sed -i '3s/^pick/squash/' "$1"
sed -i '4s/^pick/squash/' "$1"
sed -i '5s/^pick/squash/' "$1"
sed -i '6s/^pick/squash/' "$1"
sed -i '7s/^pick/squash/' "$1"
sed -i '8s/^pick/squash/' "$1"
sed -i '9s/^pick/squash/' "$1"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/rebase_script.sh

GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR=/tmp/rebase_script.sh git rebase -i HEAD~9
tool_input.description: Interactive rebase to squash all WIP commits
